subject: Re: Hosted API pricing for pilot — request for concession
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena@borealis.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2027 20:05:12 +0200
Subject: Hosted API pricing for pilot

Hi Ben / Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo today — Borealis is excited about Redwood's latency profile and the prefix caching features. We're planning a 6-month, multi-region pilot across EU/UK and would like to lock a usage rate that makes sense for our projected volume.

High level: expected sustained monthly tokens ~9M tokens (gen + embeddings) with spikes to ~18M. We're evaluating multiple vendors but prefer Redwood for reliability. That said, our procurement target needs a 28% reduction off standard published Hosted API usage rates to meet budget for this pilot.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can support that level of concession and what contractual commitment you'd need? Procurement is on a tight cadence — we'd like a signed agreement by Oct 5.

Thanks,
Elena Rossi
Head of Platform Partnerships
Borealis Analytics

---
Procurement: procure@borealis.ai
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@borealis.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2027 17:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing for pilot

Hi Elena — great to meet you today. Appreciate the frank numbers.

Short answer: We can consider a concession at that magnitude, but discounts >20% require executive approval and typically come with minimum commitment/term and payment conditions.

What I can do now: provide a commercial proposal with an ask for signoff. Preliminary terms I'm recommending to team:
- 25% off list for a 12-month committed usage (monthly minimum $45k)
- 30% off list if Borealis agrees to a 12-month prepay or 18-month commitment and provides an allowed-publicity clause
- Include Redwood's enterprise SLA and data protections (we will exclude embeddings storage for caching surcharge)

I've attached our usage forecast (based on your slide deck) and will escalate for approval — tagging Jules in the deal record.

I'll follow up once I have exec guidance.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
attachments: borealis-pilot-usage-forecast.xlsx
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 09:17:24 -0700
Subject: FWD: Hosted API pricing for pilot — Borealis asking for 28%

Team — forwarding the thread with Borealis. Requesting exec pricing authority for a concession above 20%. Context and recommended commercial structure below.

Why strategic: Borealis is a regional data platform with strong network effects in EU healthcare verticals; landing them as a reference in EU/UK unlocks marketplace partnerships (see attached forecast and public-reference ask).

Recommended concession options (pick one):
1) Approve 25% off list for 12 months, monthly minimum $50k, standard T&C with our SLA. Payment monthly.
2) Approve 30% off list conditional on 12-month prepay (or 18-month firm term) + limited marketing rights + procurement exception for data residency language.
3) Deny >20% and offer 18% + pilot credit of $40k + strict usage caps.

Key risk: margin on early months if usage under-indexes to forecast. Mitigation: include minimum invoice floor and staged usage bands.

Attachments: proposed-sla-and-tc.pdf, borealis-pilot-usage-forecast.xlsx

Can you weigh in with a clear yes/no + any constraints? We have a procurement deadline Oct 5; need final commercial language for legal.

-JW
Jonas Weber
Deal Desk / Strategic Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 11:02:45 -0400
Subject: Re: FWD: Hosted API pricing for pilot — Borealis asking for 28%

Thanks for the context, Jonas.

I'm comfortable authorizing a concession above 20% with firm commercial guardrails. Approve the 25% off list (option 1) under these conditions:
- 12-month committed term
- $50k monthly minimum invoice (true-up quarterly)
- 60-day prepayment window for the first 3 months (to reduce short-term cash exposure)
- Legal to accept standard Redwood T&Cs with a narrowly scoped data residency statement (no open-ended indemnities)
- Approved for public reference and case study post-pilot unless customer opts out in writing

I will not greenlight 30% unless procurement agrees to full 12-month prepay and Legal signs the limited exception.

Jonas, Ben — please get the contract skeleton to Legal and return with a redline. I'll sign commercial approval once Legal clears the T&Cs and finance confirms the monthly minimum.

-Mina
Mina Haddad
Head of Revenue
Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@borealis.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2027 09:45:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing for pilot — request for concession

Elena — thanks for your patience. Good news: we can support a concession to move the pilot forward.

Approved commercial offer (final):
- 25% discount off Redwood Hosted API standard usage rates
- 12-month committed term starting on signature
- $50,000 monthly minimum invoice (quarterly true-up)
- 60-day prepayment requirement for initial 3 months OR evidence of approved purchase order from procurement
- Redwood enterprise SLA and security attachments apply (attached)
- Marketing/reference agreement: Redwood may announce Borealis as a reference post-pilot unless Borealis opts out in writing

Next steps:
1) Ben will send a contract skeleton and the approved rate card (attached: approved-rate-card-borealis-25pct.pdf).
2) Borealis procurement to confirm PO or arrange prepayment.
3) Legal teams to finalize the limited data residency language in the attached terms.
4) Target signature by Oct 4 to meet your timeline.

If you need a higher concession (30%), we would need 12-month prepay + final sign-off from Head of Finance; let us know if that path is required.

Best regards,
Jonas Weber
Deal Desk / Strategic Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
